conventions.deformation: [b_j^s, a^sigma] = - gb[a^sigma,b_j^s] * kappa ; kappa odd, central, kappa^2 = 0
conventions.decomposition: [Z_a, Z_b] = sum_c C[a][b][c] Z_c  +  kappa * ( sum_c gamma[a][b][c] Z_c + gamma_scalar[a][b] * 1 )
conventions.f: f(Z_j) = sum_i phi[i][j] Z_i + phi_scalar[j] * 1 ; phi, phi_scalar are linear forms in gb
